items.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I stayed with the Shacklefords, someone’s personal home.

ctx.x: When you arrived in Hollywood, did they put you in a special hotel, could you stay in the hotels or did they put you in a rooming house?
No, I stayed with the Shacklefords, someone’s personal home.
And you stayed there how long?
